P16 gene alterations occur infrequently in non‐small cell primary lung carcinomas but are present in metastatic tumour.
P16 mutations are rare in primary NSCLC and that they are more common in node‐positive than in node‐negative tumours.

the P16 mutations in lung cancer are not common, but that they may be important in the development of metastasis.
the P16 mutations are not a frequent event in lung cancers.
